title: Communal open space in common property and behind the primary street setback line
text: C1.3.1 Communal open space is provided for apartment development in accordance with Table 1.3a and the following: i. located in common property and behind the primary street setback line;

replaces.note: R10-R25 apartments had no COS requirement (Part B 5.1.5 is grouped only)

notes: New here (no Chapter 3 equivalent; Chapter 3 has no communal open space element). Applies to developments of more than 10 dwellings (Table 1.3a 'Up to 10 dwellings: No provision'; rule condition). Threshold cliff: 11 dwellings need 66 m2 (C4P1-017). Table 2.5A: COS clauses need WAPC approval to modify (C4P1-018). Proposed facts landscape.cos.in_common_property and landscape.cos.behind_street_setback.
